atlassian.note: OAuth in your agent tool on first use — nothing to store here. Cloud only; self-hosted Data Center clients want `atlassian-self-hosted` instead.

atlassian-self-hosted.note: Runs locally via uvx (needs uv on PATH: https://astral.sh/uv). Set JIRA_URL, JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN, CONFLUENCE_URL, CONFLUENCE_PERSONAL_TOKEN in your shell/.env — asdlc only writes the ${VAR} references, never the values.

github.note: OAuth in your agent tool on first use. GitHub Enterprise Cloud: swap the url for https://copilot-api.<tenant>.ghe.com/mcp (see docs).

slack.note: A workspace admin must approve the connection once; OAuth in your agent tool after that.
